about_the_game:
Run Your Own Garage Workshop

In Craft & Deliver, you run a small workshop from your home garage. Your neighbors send requests through email, and it's your job to craft the products they need. Accept orders, produce the items in your workshop, pack them carefully, and deliver them around the neighborhood.

A calm and cozy experience with a simple work routine: produce → pack → deliver.

How to Play

In Craft & Deliver, every order comes from your neighborhood.
Check your inbox, review incoming requests, and craft the required products in your garage. The production process is handled through drag-and-drop and simple interactions. Once the product is ready, pack it up, load it into your vehicle, and deliver it around the neighborhood. Making sure the right product reaches the right person keeps your work running smoothly.

Key Features

📬 Neighborhood Order System
Receive emails from your neighbors and fulfill their requests.

🪚 Relaxing Crafting Gameplay
Cut materials, combine parts, and complete products through simple interactions.

📦 Produce → Pack → Deliver Loop
Craft items, package them, and deliver them to the right house.

🎮 Cozy 2D Experience
A relaxing atmosphere and smooth, stress-free gameplay.

🎨 Garage & Vehicle Customization
Decorate your garage and personalize your delivery vehicle.

🖱 Simple Mouse Controls
Crafting and interactions are handled through clicks and drag-and-drop.

📖 Light Story with Clear Progression
A focused experience with a beginning and an end.

Build a Small Business in Your Neighborhood

Craft & Deliver isn’t about big ambitions or stressful objectives. You help your neighbors, create with your own hands, and enjoy the steady rhythm of a small local business. Designed for players looking to relax and enjoy a calm crafting experience after a long day.

Open the garage door, check your inbox, and start your first order.
